title: You're allowed to slow down (tapri at dusk, pause reel, Painted 2D)

captions.instagram:
You're allowed to slow down. ☕🌧️

Not every evening has to be productive.
Some are just for a cup of chai, a tin roof and the sound of rain.
The messages can wait until it stops.

Send this to someone who's always rushing.

#slowliving #rest #selfcare #emotionalwellness #soundmind
